comparison.objective: Transfer support of a gravity-loaded cover and control its closure; candidate breaks and recovers tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Support handoff and velocity-controlled cover lowering versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impact regulation, safe extraction, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Cover closed within an observable speed constraint without losing support; detailed numeric rubric is absent, while the candidate requires four contained fractures and no damage.
comparison.reason: Controlled articulated-cover motion tests a different physical ability and outcome from small-scale fracture and containment.
